source.title: WCA Regulations — January 2020
source.content:
Dear WCA Community,

The WRC would like to inform you about the versions of the WCA Regulations and Guidelines, which are going into effect January 1, 2020.

You can review all changes in [this comparison on GitHub](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/compare/diff-base-2019...release-candidate-2019-12-14). You can click on “Files changed” to see the complete files of the Regulation and Guidelines, where all changes and additions are marked green and removals are red.

**Simplifications**

- Clock pins are allowed to be distinguishable. ([commit](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/62ef9340fe6af300ba670deba40e707abb96c1d9) | [discussion](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/issues/759))
- Fewest Moves: only the 18 basic moves, <x, y, z> rotations, and wide moves are allowed in solutions (no bracket rotations). ([commit](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/371a6096fd18e2881dab89678234bffd1b9efb9e) | [discussion](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/issues/757))
- The name for "combined round" has changed to "cutoff round". ([commit](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/f7facb2df8b4cfc94c739bea6ac92e3302a4a13a) | [discussion](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/issues/543))

**Accountability**

- Required: scramble signatures. Either the scrambler or a scramble checker must certify that the puzzle is scrambled correctly for each attempt. Although competitions must make a full effort to use scramble signatures for all attempts, results cannot be disqualified solely for a missing scramble signature. ([commit](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/726ae450b3de9ba3a230802c74dc2cd21f8011da) | [commit](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/e68603acbc43184c5a98bca046e96761731ace82) | [discussion](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/issues/686))
- Strongly recommended: the WCA Delegate should record a reason for each granted extra (e.g. on the back of the score sheet). ([commit](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/b6205be56a7fbc1cb43b63a4bbc440cfa9392e55))
- Strongly recommended: organizers should attach O-rings (or equivalent) to all timer buttons to prevent accidental resets. ([commit](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/b928ac93276395298a37eb8bc2eca2d779df13c2) | [discussion](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/issues/243))

**Miscellaneous**

- 3x3x3 With Feet will no longer be an official event. ([announcement](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/posts/removing-official-status-for-3x3x3-with-feet) | [commit](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/2963df6381c3e06ca2ce654926a4d996eab3defe) | [discussion](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/issues/652))
- Fewest Moves solutions are considered public. ([commit](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/6cbabf32e41ebf9e8197232aa10e8fe03db15fbe) | [discussion](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/issues/125))
- Multi-Blind: if a duplicate cube is found and during an attempt, the cube may be re-scrambled using an extra scramble. ([commit](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/1d8c92dbda3f1e4f86e7100b522e382661db67bf) | [discussion](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/issues/766))
- Clock stands may be used to place the Clock vertically at the solving station at the beginning of the attempt. ([commit](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/b2db7e13684ae671a8e0e3565524ce88739a83bd) | [discussion](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/issues/382))

translation.title: WCA 规则更新：2020 年 1 月
translation.content:
亲爱的 WCA 社区成员：

WCA 规则委员会（WRC）在此向大家介绍将于 2020 年 1 月 1 日生效的新版 WCA 规则与指南。

全部改动可在[此 GitHub 对比页面](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/compare/diff-base-2019...release-candidate-2019-12-14)查看。点击“Files changed”可以查看规则与指南的完整文件，修改或新增的内容标为绿色，删除的内容标为红色。

**简化规则**

* 允许魔表的按针彼此可区分。（[提交](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/62ef9340fe6af300ba670deba40e707abb96c1d9) | [讨论](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/issues/759)）
* 最少步：解法只允许使用 18 种基本转动、x、y、z 整体转动以及宽层转动，不允许使用方括号整体转动记号。（[提交](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/371a6096fd18e2881dab89678234bffd1b9efb9e) | [讨论](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/issues/757)）
* “组合轮次”（combined round）更名为“设及格线的轮次”（cutoff round）。（[提交](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/f7facb2df8b4cfc94c739bea6ac92e3302a4a13a) | [讨论](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/issues/543)）

**责任确认**

* 必须进行打乱签名：每次还原前，打乱员或打乱检查员须确认魔方已正确打乱。虽然比赛必须尽力确保每次还原都有打乱签名，但不能仅因缺少打乱签名而取消成绩。（[提交](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/726ae450b3de9ba3a230802c74dc2cd21f8011da) | [提交](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/e68603acbc43184c5a98bca046e96761731ace82) | [讨论](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/issues/686)）
* 强烈建议 WCA 代表记录每次批准额外还原的原因，例如写在成绩单背面。（[提交](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/b6205be56a7fbc1cb43b63a4bbc440cfa9392e55)）
* 强烈建议主办方在所有计时器按钮上安装 O 形圈或类似装置，防止意外复位。（[提交](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/b928ac93276395298a37eb8bc2eca2d779df13c2) | [讨论](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/issues/243)）

**其他改动**

* 三阶脚拧不再是官方项目。（[公告](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/posts/removing-official-status-for-3x3x3-with-feet) | [提交](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/2963df6381c3e06ca2ce654926a4d996eab3defe) | [讨论](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/issues/652)）
* 最少步解法视为公开资料。（[提交](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/6cbabf32e41ebf9e8197232aa10e8fe03db15fbe) | [讨论](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/issues/125)）
* 多盲：如果在还原过程中发现重复的魔方，可使用备打重新打乱该魔方。（[提交](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/1d8c92dbda3f1e4f86e7100b522e382661db67bf) | [讨论](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/issues/766)）
* 允许在一次还原开始时使用魔表支架，将魔表竖直放置在比赛台上。（[提交](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/b2db7e13684ae671a8e0e3565524ce88739a83bd) | [讨论](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/issues/382)）
